newsitem.title: USA: Urban Shopping awarded three contracts.
newsitem.headline: Urban Shopping awarded three contracts.

text.p: Urban Shopping Centers Inc said Wednesday its property management affiliate, Urban Retail Properties Co, has assumed management, leasing and marketing for three additional retail properties.
The properties include the North Riverside Park Mall in North Riverside, Ill.; Assembly Square Mall, Somerville, Mass., and Tampa Plaza Shopping Center, Tampa, Fla.
Urban Shopping declined to disclose the value of the contracts.
Urban Retail Properties manages more than 55 million square feet of space in 23 states and District of Columbia.
